# studiesmultiverse — Standing Register

> The worldwide record of which institutions are officially permitted to enrol
> international students, and which have quietly left those registers.

This site earns nothing from where you apply. It carries no institution referral fees,
no agent commissions, no paid inclusion and no paid removal.

## What is here

- **Australia** — Commonwealth Register of Institutions and Courses for Overseas Students (CRICOS) (Australian Government Department of Education). 57 editions held since 2021-10-31; 42521 changes recorded. Data: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/multiverseadmin/studiesmultiverse-standing/main/public/au-cricos/changes.json
- **Canada** — Designated learning institutions list (Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada (IRCC)). 364 editions held since 2018-02-01; 1897 changes recorded. Data: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/multiverseadmin/studiesmultiverse-standing/main/public/ca-dli/changes.json
- **Japan** — 認定日本語教育機関 — accredited Japanese-language education institutions (文部科学省 (Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology)). 1 editions held since 2026-08-25; 0 changes recorded. Data: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/multiverseadmin/studiesmultiverse-standing/main/public/jp-mext/changes.json
- **United Kingdom** — Register of licensed student sponsors (UK Home Office). 3 editions held since 2026-08-25; 5 changes recorded. Data: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/multiverseadmin/studiesmultiverse-standing/main/public/uk-sponsors/changes.json

## How to cite

Every change entry carries the edition dates it was derived from and a SHA-256 of the
archived source edition. Cite the edition date, not the date you read the page.

## What we will not say

A row disappearing from a register is not evidence of wrongdoing. We never write that an
institution was revoked, banned, or shut down. We write that it is no longer listed on the
edition published on a given date, and we name the alternatives — withdrawal, merger,
rename, voluntary surrender, lapse at renewal, or publisher correction — in the same breath.

Corrections: https://studiesmultiverse.com/standing/corrections/
